learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamentals of computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) and apply them to programming machine tools using numerical control.
Be able to simulate the manufacturing process of a part using CAM software and fabricate it using numerically controlled machine tools in the laboratory.
Understand the fundamentals of Metrology and its industrial application.
Identify and apply different techniques and strategies to ensure Quality in manufacturing processes.

syllabus_topics: Metrology and quality in manufacturing processes.
Influence of the human factor on quality.
Dimensional metrology - Length and angular standards.
Dimensional metrology - Length and angle measuring instruments.
Dimensional metrology - Calibration and measurement process.
teaching_methods: Classroom presentation of concepts and problem solving.
assessment_rules: For continuous assessment, the final grade is calculated as: 1st Partial (20%), 2nd Partial (40%), Work (20%), and Practical Exercises (20%). If the continuous assessment is not passed, the student may take an exam covering the entire course, including a practical part, in the ordinary call. The final grade in this case will be the one obtained in this exam. The same rule applies for the extraordinary call if the ordinary call is not passed.
